title: Add Cost Model API Grafana dashboards (latency/errors, schema version dist, drift)
author: Allison Grant
description: Summary: Adds a Grafana folder + dashboards for the Cost Model API so Console/Optimize rollouts have a single place to monitor health, adoption, and correctness drift. Includes panels for request volume, p50/p95/p99 latency, error-rate by code, schema version distribution, request-bounds rejections, cache hit/miss (client-side + service memoization), and a first pass of drift metrics (predicted vs observed) sourced from the scheduled drift job. Motivation: During early Console integration testing we saw two recurring issues: (1) latency spikes due to cardinality blowups on hot paths and (2) drift alerts firing due to telemetry lag vs genuine mismatch. This PR standardizes the dashboards and bakes in guardrail signals (telemetry freshness, missing inputs) so oncall can quickly triage. Related: redwood/pr-28457 (service endpoints), redwood/pr-28490 (drift monitoring job), redwood/pr-28495 (what-if guardrails), SUP-31905 (latency spike report). What’s included (dashboards): 1) "Cost Model API / Overview" (high-level SLO views): RPS, concurrency, saturation, p50/p95/p99 latency, error budget burn (5m/1h/6h), top tenants (bounded), and a "schema negotiation" panel showing unknown/unsupported versions returned to clients. 2) "Cost Model API / Errors & Bounds" (debug): error rate split by status, error_code, and stage; panels for bound rejections (e.g., breakdown_group_by too high-cardinality), request payload size buckets, and timeouts by caller (console-backend vs optimize-service). 3) "Cost Model API / Schema Version Adoption": distribution of requested schema_version vs served schema_version (incl. fallback), percent of clients sending optional fields for cache/batching/quantization; includes a heatmap of version by environment. 4) "Cost Model / Drift": predicted_cost_usd vs observed_cost_usd (daily + hourly), drift pct, confidence bands where available, and triage panels: telemetry lag (ingestion watermark age), missing-runtime-input rate, and "prefill/decode split present" ratio. Alerts: Adds two alert rules (behind the existing oncall routing policy): (a) p95 latency > 300ms for 10m (scoped to prod + excluding canary envs), (b) drift_pct > 5% for 6h AND telemetry_lag < 15m (to reduce false positives during pipeline delays). Notes: Drift is expected to be noisy early; the dashboard intentionally surfaces "telemetry freshness" next to drift so oncall can distinguish pipeline lag from real regression. Implementation details: Dashboards live under grafana/dashboards/cost-model-api/*.jsonnet and are rendered to JSON in CI. Metrics consumed assume the cost-model service exports: cost_model_api_request_duration_seconds (histogram), cost_model_api_requests_total (by status, error_code, caller, env), cost_model_api_schema_version_served_total, and drift job exports: cost_model_drift_ratio, cost_model_drift_pct, cost_model_observed_cost_usd, cost_model_predicted_cost_usd, telemetry_watermark_age_seconds. Rollout: Once merged, SRE will deploy the updated observability pack on the next release train; Console rollout doc will link to these dashboards. Screenshots: Added to the internal docs PR separately (redwood-docs/pr-1187) to avoid bloating this repo.

Allison Grant (author): Added telemetry_watermark_age_seconds panels + updated the drift alert condition to require watermark < 15m. Also added a single-stat "Telemetry freshness" on the drift dashboard header.
Thomas Baird: For the top tenants panel, please ensure the query is bounded. We’ve had Grafana queries time out when someone does topk across unbounded label sets.
Allison Grant (author): Updated to use a pre-aggregated recording rule (caller/env scoped) and capped at top 10 tenants; also added a note in the dashboard description about not removing the cap.
Logan Wright: The metric name in the JSONNET uses telemetry_watermark_age, but the exporter is telemetry_watermark_age_seconds. Please fix for consistency with other pipelines.
Allison Grant (author): Fixed metric names + added a metrics.libsonnet constant for the drift job outputs to avoid typos.
Ethan Park: Can we break out latency by endpoint? Estimate vs breakdown vs what-if have different characteristics and the team will ask for it immediately.

Allison Grant (author): Added a latency-by-route panel (route label) in Overview, and a small callout in Errors & Bounds that what-if is expected to be higher latency; also included a filter variable for route.
Rafael Mendes (SRE): Approving with the guardrails. Please make sure the alerts are routed to cost-model oncall and not the generic platform rotation.
Allison Grant (author): Confirmed routing uses team=cost-model-api label and matches the existing policy bundle. Added this to the README section.
release_notes: Added Grafana dashboards + alert rules for Cost Model API health (latency/errors), schema version adoption, and drift monitoring with telemetry freshness guardrails.
